components.text: Diesel and Fuel are the [color=yellow]refined products[color] of the oil chain, used to power machines and rockets.
The chain starts with [ref=stellaris:items/oil]Oil[ref], which you locate with the [ref=stellaris:items/oil_finder]Oil Finder[ref] and extract using a [ref=stellaris:machines/pumpjack]Pumpjack[ref].
The [ref=stellaris:machines/fuel_refinery]Fuel Refinery[ref] then turns oil into Fuel and Diesel. [br] Diesel powers a Diesel Generator, while Fuel is what your rocket burns to reach space.
